method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reconstruction of each symbol-class interpretation and arity, replay of the arithmetic and set-theory examples, verification of the quantified validity and two existential-generalization patterns, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: First-order structures and interpretations, arithmetic and set-theory examples, hereditarily finite sets, and the logical effects of domain and denotation conventions.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A first-order language is initially uninterpreted. A structure supplies a nonempty domain, a domain element for every constant, an n-ary domain relation for every non-identity n-ary predicate, and an n-ary domain function for every n-ary function symbol. Structure, interpretation and model are variant names in the literature.
samples.checks: The nonempty condition, exclusion of identity from assigned predicates, all domain powers and function codomains, and the literature-name qualification are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: An arithmetic-language structure interprets zero, successor, addition, multiplication and order. The usual natural-number interpretation is the standard model, but integer-domain and even nonnumerical structures for the same vocabulary are possible.
samples.checks: Every symbol, arity, displayed assignment, natural-number condition and the contrast between language vocabulary and its interpretation are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A set-theory-language structure needs a domain and one binary relation, so even people with an older-than relation or naturals with greater-than-or-equal can interpret it. The HF structure instead has the cumulative finite powerset union as domain and actual membership as its relation.
samples.checks: The intentionally nonstandard examples, both ordered-pair membership conditions and every level of the displayed powerset union are retained. The malformed source hyphen in ‘single-two’ is corrected only in prose and disclosed as OLFOL-010.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Requiring a nonempty domain makes the displayed existential excluded-middle sentence valid under ordinary quantified satisfaction. Requiring constants to denote within the domain licenses existential generalization. Free logic can relax denotation and consequently adds the displayed existence premise.
samples.checks: The logical-truth qualification, ordinary inference direction, two ways denotation can fail, and the stronger free-logic premise pattern are all preserved.

source_observations: OLFOL-010 records the source's grammatical ‘single-two place relation’ defect; the intended one binary relation is fixed by the surrounding definition.
The translation distinguishes a language's uninterpreted symbols from the structure that interprets them and reserves प्रतिमान for the model label.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The exact Marathi headwords for structure/interpretation, free logic and hereditarily finite set remain explicitly open to specialist review in T218–T220.
